exposure: Measles vaccination (routine two-dose schedule at 8/18 months)
cohort: The study included 408 children (0-12 years) who received China's routine measles vaccination schedule and 222 adults (54-84 years) who acquired immunity through natural infection from Anhua County, Hunan Province, China.
finding: Vaccine-induced measles antibody levels declined below the protective threshold by age 15.8 and decayed significantly faster than naturally acquired antibodies, with a more rapid decline observed in vaccine-induced immunity for children born after 2010 compared to those born before 2010.
followup_time: Up to 84 years (age of oldest participant in the adult cohort)
